verdict.rationale: Zoho Books has a documented Journal Entries-capable API, OAuth-based agent access, and MCP integration for agent-driven bookkeeping actions, plus accountant collaboration features, which together make agent-drafted journal entries plausible. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'draft/review queue' status or approval workflow for journal entries specifically, nor confirmation that journal entries can be created in a pending/unposted state for accountant review via API. missing for 10: explicit journal entry draft/pending status API field, a documented review-queue or approval workflow feature, and a hands-on example of an agent posting a journal entry that awaits accountant sign-off.
